title: Backyard patio and planting in Royal Bay

seo.title: Sample project: Royal Bay backyard patio
seo.description: Sample case study: a sloping Royal Bay backyard in Colwood regraded, levelled with a low wall and finished with a paver patio and planting.

summary: A bare new-build backyard finished with a patio, retaining wall and planting.
challenge: A bare new-build backyard sloped toward the house and held water against the foundation every winter.
approach: We regraded so surface water ran away from the foundation, then built a low block retaining wall to level an area for the patio.
Pavers went down on a compacted base, the lawn area was sodded, and the border was planted with native shrubs that cope with dry summers.
result: A level, usable yard that drains away from the house.
links: Read more about [landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/), see our work in [Colwood](/areas/colwood/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
story: The yard sloped toward the house and held water in winter.
We regraded away from the foundation, built a low retaining wall to level the patio area and planted the border with native shrubs that handle dry summers.
